_comment: Per-agent value rules. For each agent, map an event type to the hours and dollars it saves. Edit these per client — they're your assumptions, kept honest and visible. 'hours' feeds the labor-value math (hours x hourly_rate); 'dollars' is direct value (e.g. a captured lead). Add a new agent by adding a block like these.

security-scan.label: Automated network security scan (vs manual audit)

_assumptions: Savannah's 'appointment-booked' is valued at $500 = expected value, not cash: a booked AI-efficiency audit converting at ~25% to a $2,000 assessment. 'lead-captured' at $200 is a qualified caller with a callback number but no booking. Misrouted or unusable calls earn 'call-answered' only — the agent still did the work of answering, but no lead exists. Change these per client; they are assumptions, kept visible on purpose.

appointment-booked.label: Appointment booked straight to the calendar
